{'WhatsApp is rolling out three upgrades to group chats starting today, including improvements to polls, a way to start a new chat from an existing group, and more.': 'WhatsApp 今日起為群組聊天推出三項升級，包括投票功能改進、從現有群組建立新聊天的方式，以及更多功能。'}

{'WhatsApp Adds Improved Polls, @Everyone Mentions, More': 'WhatsApp 新增投票功能加強、「@全體」標註功能等'}

{'WhatsApp today announced three improvements coming to group chats.': 'WhatsApp 今日公佈將為群組聊天推出三項改進功能。'}

{'Polls are the headliner here, with several improvements to just that one feature:': '投票功能是今次更新的重點，僅投票一項便有多項升級：'}

  • {'You can now hide who voted, allowing everyone to share their opinion with peace of mind': '現在可以隱藏投票者姓名，讓每個人都能安心發表意見'}
  • {'You can now set an end date, locking the poll after a specified deadline': '你現在可以設定結束時間，在指定截止時間後鎖定投票'}
  • {'Polls can be edited up to 15 minutes after being posted': '投票發佈後最多可在 15 分鐘內進行編輯'}

{'Support for @all mentions is another group chat feature rolling out today. This is a quick and easy way to get everyone’s attention in a chat. WhatsApp says:': '支援 @all 標註是另一項今日推出的群組聊天功能。這是在聊天中迅速便捷地引起所有人注意的方式。WhatsApp 表示：'}

{'Finally, you can now easily start a new group chat from an existing group.': '最後，你現在可以輕鬆從現有群組建立新的群組聊天。'}

{'For whatever reason, if you need to split off a topic or shared item into its own chat, it now only takes a few taps. You can find the ‘create similar group’ button in the group details page.': '無論出於何種原因，如果你需要將某個討論話題或共享項目分拆到獨立的聊天中，現在只需輕點幾下即可。你可以在群組詳細資料頁面找到「建立類似群組」按鈕。'}

{'WhatsApp recently also rolled out Apple Music sharing, the ability to register on iPad without a phone number, and more.': 'WhatsApp 近期亦推出了 Apple Music 分享功能、無需電話號碼即可在 iPad 上註冊等功能。'}

{'What other group chat features are still on your WhatsApp wishlist? Let us know in the comments.': '你的 WhatsApp 心願清單上還有哪些未實現的群組聊天功能？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。'}

{'Best iPhone Accessories': '最佳 iPhone 配件'}

  • {'AirPods Pro 3 (Now $199, was $249)': 'AirPods Pro 3（現僅售 $199，原價 $249）'}
  • {'iPhone MagSafe Car Mount': 'iPhone MagSafe 車用支架'}
  • {'10-Year AirTag Battery Case': '10 年續航 AirTag 電池保護殼'}
  • {'100W USB-C Fast Charger Power Adapter': '100W USB-C 快速充電電源轉接器'}
  • {'AirTag 2 (1-pack / 4-pack)': 'AirTag 2（1 個裝 / 4 個裝）'}
